consequence.statement: Monitoring systems scraping the `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` metric will no longer receive data; the metric is available under the new name `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`.

original.statement: The `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` metric has been renamed to `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade the identity kvstore double-write metric is exposed as `doublewrite_kvstore_identities` instead of `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count`. Dashboards, alerts or recording rules that use the old name will not match the renamed series.
consequence.remediation: Update any dashboards, alerts and recording rules that refer to `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` so they use `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`.

corrected.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` is renamed to `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`. The data is still exposed under the new name, so monitoring that refers to the old name should be reviewed.

decision.reason: [ev-2349d1c09109] only says, under "Changed Metrics", that the metric `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` was renamed to `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`. A metric is an emitted output, not a configured value, so setting-ignored is the wrong kind. The evidence also says nothing fails or must be migrated. The data is still exposed under the new name, so the most this supports is a review-class behavior-change: dashboards and alerts that use the old name should be checked.
